chunk: The Harbour Bridge opened in March 1932 after eight years of construction. It carries eight lanes of road traffic and two railway lines. Around 160,000 vehicles cross it each day.
spans: The Harbour Bridge opened in March 1932 after eight years of construction.

chunk: Crews repaint the steel arch continuously ; one full coat takes about ten years . The arch rises 134 metres above the water.
spans: The arch rises 134 metres above the water.

chunk: Tolls are collected electronically in both directions.
The bridge was designed by a team led by John Bradfield. Its granite pylons carry no load.
